title: THE STASH KEY ROW IS READABLE
why: Found by the same 4K menu text scan of 2026-10-08: the key row under the stash (DRAG move, RIGHT CLICK all actions, SHIFT, CTRL, ALT, 1-9, and the controller row of v19.70) was set at 10.5 pixels on a row half empty. It is 12.5 now and still one line.
now: The key row under the stash is easier to read.

edits.replacement: font-size:12.5px; letter-spacing:.13em; color:var(--ash); text-transform:uppercase; }   /* v16.xx, seen on a 4K menu text scan (2026-10-08): 10.5px, the smallest print in any menu, on a row half empty */
